interfaces.wrapper: local copy of accepted nonblock_actual_dma_system_top.sv; original iDMA/IOMMU unchanged; replace disabled synthetic CPU master at existing real xbar slv0 with actual wt_cache_subsystem AXI
interfaces.cache_cpu: deterministic one outstanding CPU physical load port1/store port2; addr index/tag, data_req/tag_valid, BE,size; waits actual grants/load responses; controller fence_i_i pulse and actual halt/flush_ack
interfaces.icache: actual cva6_icache included; request/fetch held inactive; controller flush_icache connected and traced
interfaces.shared_memory: same existing DDR model and backing map after actual cache AXI passes original xbar; no second cache memory model
interfaces.initialization: Backing allocation/zero default pre-reset only. Actual frozen pool, all fixed tables, metadata and headers written through real CPU cache ports before startup acquire/common-ready.
interfaces.metadata: PA 0x80004000 + (packet_id-1)*64; 64B per packet, outside original16KiB DMA pool, 16B lines; generation,cookie,used_bytes,acquire_nonce,consumer_done,B_returned,source_reuse_retired,reserved as 8-byte fields
interfaces.alias: CPU port physical address 0x80000000+offset; no virtual/MMU execution. DMA IOVA0x10000000+offset translated by DID10/11 original2MiB resident leaf to same PA. One physical backing, no second cacheable alias.

gates.complete_packet_acquire: all span public DONE match, legal successor NEXT/preparation before prefix service, then actual controller/cache fence completion; closure reads only owned packet until globalquiet
gates.source_reuse: actual WT CPU writes only after source read retirement; drain wbuffer/MSHR before source-reuse completion event
gates.metadata: actual cache stores and later cache loads around logical used/consumer/return boundaries; final all backing inspected through CPU load after checked quiet

execution_plan: new same-binary microtests: stale after actual DMA without acquire; visible after actual controller acquire; fence waits pending WT store/MSHR
root review of this interface plan/config and build/microtest results before integration
same binary single_FIFO_ahead once and parallel_FIFO_ahead once; no old matrix replay

traces.events.csv: inherited MMIO/DMA/protocol events plus fence_begin/complete metadata and ownership events
traces.cache_axi.csv: every cycle all cache-side AXI channels with valid/ready,id,address,len,size,data,strb,last,resp
traces.memory_axi.csv: every cycle DDR channels tagged IDs, addresses and masks, complete raw responses

limits.peer_overlap_claim: measure original schedule only; absent is explicit absent
